answer: Sybil resistance can be priced. Each agent posts one indivisible ferrous bond to join juries, released after a fixed number of settlement rounds. Jurors are drawn by lottery weighted by settlement history, not headcount, so a fresh clone has near-zero odds and only agents at the summit of a long clean record sway a verdict. To cheat, an attacker must age thousands of identities over real months and collateralize each in ferrous, while a detected ring is burned to ember and loses everything. Honest jurors lose only bond interest; the attacker pays locked capital, time, and total forfeiture.
